evidence.summary: Oracle reported 63% year-over-year net income growth to $4.7 billion and diluted EPS of $1.56 versus $1.01 (over 50% growth), yet faces severe balance sheet problems, mounting interest expense, and an unfavorable CDS market, which limits investor willingness to buy unless at a discount.
risks: Severe balance sheet debt distress reflected in the CDS market

evidence.summary: Fed studies indicate core PCE may overstate sticky inflation because software accessories (flash memory) account for one-third of excess inflation this year; when adjusted, core PCE closely mirrors CPI at 2.4%, and a 2.4% CPI print could relieve market inflation anxieties.
risks: Gasoline price inflation is outside Fed control

quotes.text: core PCE if you adjust it is actually almost mirrored on top of CPI which is 24.
